Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.Enabled: Shop loot is lost gradually over time. Off: nothing is changed.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.StartDa: Days since the apocalypse. Before this day no loot is lost.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.PeakDay: The loss is fastest up to this day, then slows down.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.EndDay_: From this day on shops keep the minimum loot.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.Slowdow: Higher: the loss slows down faster after the peak.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.ExactCu: Points day:percent of the loss done, separated by ; for example 0:0;7:57;360:100. none uses the formula.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.Initial: Part of the final loss already done on the start day.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.HighCha: High priority: chance of the full loss (percent)
Share of these shops that lose the full amount: they keep only the minimum loot at the end. The others lose less.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.HighPea: High priority: loot left at the peak (percent)
Loot a fully hit shop keeps on the peak day.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.HighMin: High priority: minimum loot at the end (percent)
Loot a fully hit shop keeps from the end day on.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.MediumC: Medium priority: chance of the full loss (percent)
Share of these shops that lose the full amount: they keep only the minimum loot at the end. The others lose less.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.MediumP: Medium priority: loot left at the peak (percent)
Loot a fully hit shop keeps on the peak day.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.MediumM: Medium priority: minimum loot at the end (percent)
Loot a fully hit shop keeps from the end day on.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.LowChan: Low priority: chance of the full loss (percent)
Share of these shops that lose the full amount: they keep only the minimum loot at the end. The others lose less.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.LowPeak: Low priority: loot left at the peak (percent)
Loot a fully hit shop keeps on the peak day.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.LowMinL: Low priority: minimum loot at the end (percent)
Loot a fully hit shop keeps from the end day on.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.LuckyLo: The shops that escaped the full loss lose this share of the full loss, or more.
The shops that escaped the full loss lose this share of the full loss, or less.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.Overrun: Hospitals, prisons, police and army get this much extra loot once, when first filled. They never lose loot.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.UsefulF: Same amount lost, but food, medicine, tools and weapons go first.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.Protect: After a building is loaded, no loot is removed while the player is this close to it or has looked at its containers. Removal waits for the next load or for the player to be farther away.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.RecentV: Recent visit: days the loss pauses
After the player enters a shop or opens one of its containers, its loss pauses for this many days, then restarts gradually. 0: no pause.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.BaseIte: Items stored to count as a base
A shop where the player stored this many items is a base and never loses loot.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.BaseAct: Days of use to count as a base
A shop where the player opened containers or moved items on this many different days is a base and never loses loot.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.ApplyOn: Apply on the game's loot respawn
A container refilled by the game's loot respawn goes to the shop's current loot, and overrun places get the bonus again.
Sandbox_ImmersiveLootedBuildings.LogDeci: Writes each update to the console (for debugging).
